sections.title: Parties and purpose
sections.body: Buyer: {buyer}. Supplier: {supplier}. Reference: {code}. This test fixture reflects the form and is not legal advice.

sections.title: Scope of work
sections.body: The supplier delivers the work described by the contract title and its milestones. Evidence must belong to this contract and the correct event type.

sections.title: Contract value
sections.body: Value is stated in million VND with two decimal places. Payment follows the rule version pinned to the contract.

sections.title: Milestones and payment
sections.body: The milestones below come from the configured workflow template. A reviewer must confirm the dates before issuance.

sections.title: Acceptance evidence
sections.body: Evidence must be provided by this contract supplier. Incomplete documents or invalid signatures do not authorize payment.

sections.title: Approval policy
sections.body: Approval policy: {approvalPolicy}. Only the assigned roles and parties may vote. Contract signing does not replace payment approval.

sections.title: Signers and order
sections.body: Signers act in the order shown below. The final step requires digital signing. The same person cannot occupy two steps.

sections.title: Late penalty and grace
sections.body: Start date: {startDate}. End date: {endDate}. Grace period: {graceDays} days. Penalty rate: {penaltyRatePct}% per day.

sections.title: Liability cap
sections.body: Penalty cap: {maxPenaltyPct}%. The engine uses exact decimal formulas and records decision reasons in the audit trail.

sections.title: Warranty and support
sections.body: The warranty milestone opens only after its predecessor completes. Required evidence follows the configured contract workflow.

sections.title: Disputes
sections.body: An open dispute holds release. The controller handles exceptions; system administration does not confer business approval authority.

sections.title: Change control
sections.body: A rule change needs a version, reason, regression check and independent reviewer. Existing contracts retain their pinned version.

sections.title: Effect and retention
sections.body: The contract becomes effective when all configured signing steps complete. This fixture is unsigned; demo LOCAL_ED25519 proof is not an externally trusted CA/PAdES certificate.

single: Single signer: this signature completes the configured signing workflow.
multiple: Multiple signers: all steps must complete in order, representing both parties.
signHere: Signature area — name, timestamp and method
